NONE: › a feeling or character that a person or place seems to have
› a type of light that some people say they can see around people and animals
（一些人聲稱在人或動物身體周圍看到的）光環，光輪

example: The woods have an aura of mystery.
這片樹林透著神秘的氣息。
There's an aura of sadness about him.
他看上去一副悲傷的樣子。

NONE: › a bright circle of light, especially around the head
（尤指環繞人頭部的）光環，光輪

C: › one of the two spaces in the top part of the heart that receive blood from the veins and push it down into the ventricles (= lower spaces)
心房（心臟的一部分，在心室的後上方，左右各一，接收經靜脈回心的血液並將其送入心室）
› also pinna the part of the ear on the outside of the head

NONE: › relating to the external part of the ear
› relating to an auricle (= upper space) in the heart

example: The study evaluated the effect of auricular acupuncture in 20 cancer patients.
該研究評估了耳部針灸對20例癌症病患的功效。

NONE: › any of the three muscles that are attached to the external part of the ear and help to move the scalp or the external part of the ear itself
